Rashi on Nedarim 22a:10:1.hebrew: לב רגז - היינו כעס. בשביל לב רגז יהיה כליון עינים:
Rashi on Nedarim 22a:10:1.english: A trembling heart - This is anger. Because of a trembling heart, there will be failing of eyes.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:11:1.english: On his ascent - When he went up to the Land of Israel.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:11:3.english: Residents of Ḥozai - They were Jews.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:11:4.hebrew: א"ל אין ופרע לו בית שחיטה - ונתיירא לומר לו שלא עשה יפה, שמא יהרגנו:
Rashi on Nedarim 22a:11:4.english: He said to him: Yes, and open for him the place of slaughter - And [Ulla] was afraid to tell him that he had not acted properly, lest he kill him.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:11:5.english: When he came - Ulla [came] before Rabbi Yochanan.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:11:6.english: He said: Perhaps I strengthened the hands of sinners - Because I said to him: "Go and open the place of the slaughter."

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:11:7.hebrew: א"ל יפה עשית - שכך אמרת לו, שנפשך הצלת באותו דיבור:
Rashi on Nedarim 22a:11:7.english: He said to him: You did well - [Meaning] that you spoke thus to him, for you saved your life with that statement.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:12:1.hebrew: תמה ר' יוחנן - על דהוה ליה לההוא בר חוזאה כעס כל כך שהרג לחבירו, הואיל דהוה בארץ ישראל:
Rashi on Nedarim 22a:12:1.english: Rabbi Yochanan wondered - [He wondered] over that man from Choza'ah having so much anger that he killed his fellow, since he was in the Land of Israel.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:1:1.english: Had her mother not seen in her - Were it not that her mother saw in her.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:1:2.hebrew: מילין דעזיבה - דברים שיפין להניחן, כלומר דבר זימה:
Rashi on Nedarim 22a:1:2.english: Matters of abandonment - Things that are fitting to abandon, that is to say, a matter of immorality.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:1:3.hebrew: בכדי לא אדרת - בחנם לא היתה מדירתה ומלעיזין עליה, מי היית מדירה? הכא ליכא למשמע אי פותחין אי לא:
Rashi on Nedarim 22a:1:3.english: She would not have prohibited [her] by a vow for nothing - she would not have prohibited her by a vow for no reason, and [people] mock her — would you have prohibited her by a vow? Here, one cannot learn whether we open [a vow] or not.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:2:1.hebrew: שמבקרין מעשיך - בב"ד של מעלה בשביל שנדרת:
Rashi on Nedarim 22a:2:1.english: That they examine your deeds - In the heavenly court, because you vowed.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:3:1.english: What is the verse - That because of vows, a person's deeds are examined.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:3:2.english: And after vows to make inquiry - For if one vows, his deeds are examined.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:4:1.hebrew: ולא פתחינן - לשום אדם בהאי "אחר נדרים לבקר", משום דהוי איום גדול, שאפי' אין דעתו להפר, יאמר עכשיו שרצונו להפר. ולא בהני תרתי אחרנייתא נמי, משום דהוי איום גדול, ואומר שדעתו להפר ואינו כן:
Rashi on Nedarim 22a:4:1.english: And we do not broach - for any person with this [verse], "after vows to make inquiry," because it is a great intimidation, for even if his intention is not to annul [the vow], he will say now that his wish is to annul [it]. And neither [do we broach] with these two other [methods] as well, because it is a great intimidation, and he says that his intention is to annul [it] when it is not so.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:4:2.hebrew: כל הבוטה - כל הנודר, כמו מבטא שפתיה (במדבר ל):
Rashi on Nedarim 22a:4:2.english: Anyone who utters - Anyone who takes a vow, like "the utterance of her lips" (Numbers 30).

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:4:3.english: And the tongue of the wise is health - That they [the Sages] dissolve [the vow] for him.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:5:1.english: As if he built a high place - for idol worship.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:5:2.hebrew: ברישא פתחינן - בתחילת דבריו של ר' נתן, דאמר כאילו בנה במה, פתחינן ליה, דלא הוי עונשו יתירא כל אימת דלא עבד עלה קרבן, וליכא איום כל כך. אבל בסיפא — כאילו מקטיר עליה, מתחייב מיתה — היינו איום יתירא:
Rashi on Nedarim 22a:5:2.english: With the first clause, we may broach - With the beginning of Rabbi Natan's statement, where he says [that one who vows is] as if he built a personal altar, we may broach [dissolution] for him, for his punishment is not [so] severe as long as he has not offered a sacrifice upon it, and there is not so much intimidation. However, with the latter clause — [where he says it is] as if he burns [an offering] upon it, [for which] one becomes liable to death — that is excessive intimidation.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:6:1.english: In the latter clause - Everyone agrees [that] we do not broach [dissolution].

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:7:1.hebrew: כי תחדל לנדור לא יהיה בך חטא - מכלל דאי נדר ועבד ליה, איכא חטא:
Rashi on Nedarim 22a:7:1.english: If you refrain from vowing, there will be no sin in you - This implies that if one vows and fulfills it, there is sin.

Rashi on Nedarim 22a:8:1.hebrew: כנדרי רשעים - אע"פ שנודרים ומקיימין, איקרו רשעים:
Rashi on Nedarim 22a:8:1.english: Like the vows of the wicked - Even though they vow and fulfill [their vows], they are called wicked.
